title: Burnham brings forward ban on 'subscription traps' to ease cost of living
summary: The UK Prime Minister is advancing a ban on 'subscription traps' as part of efforts to reduce living costs for consumers. This announcement comes as part of a broader UK tour focused on addressing cost-of-living concerns.
content: The prime minister is embarking on a UK tour with a series of announcements aimed at easing living costs.

zh.title: 伯纳姆推进禁止"订阅陷阱"以缓解生活成本
zh.summary: 英国首相正推进禁止"订阅陷阱"的措施，以帮助减轻消费者的生活成本。这一宣布是更广泛的英国访问活动的一部分，旨在解决生活成本问题。

title: Australian rare earth miner surges as much as 29% after U.S. Department of War investment
summary: An Australian rare earth mining company surged up to 29% following U.S. Department of War investment backing for a scandium mine project. The Trump administration is supporting the initiative to reduce China's dominance in critical minerals.
content: The Trump administration has backed plans to build an Australian scandium mine as part of a push to challenge China’s critical-minerals dominance.

zh.title: 澳大利亚稀土矿商因美国国防部投资激增29%
zh.summary: 澳大利亚稀土矿业公司在获得美国国防部对钪矿项目的投资支持后，股价暴涨至29%。特朗普政府正在支持该举措以减少中国在关键矿物领域的主导地位。

title: Tech leaders say AI means less work - their staff say they work up to 90 hours a week
summary: Tech company leaders claim AI will reduce work burdens and increase free time, but employees report working 90-hour weeks, revealing a significant gap between executive rhetoric and workplace reality. The discrepancy highlights ongoing questions about AI's actual impact on work conditions.
content: Tech companies are not modelling their own claims of the technology giving people more free time.

zh.title: 科技领袖称人工智能意味着工作减少——员工称他们每周工作90小时
zh.summary: 科技公司领导人声称人工智能将减少工作负担并增加闲暇时间，但员工报告每周工作长达90小时，这暴露了高管言辞与工作场所现实之间的巨大差距。这种矛盾突显了人工智能对工作条件的实际影响仍存在的疑问。

title: Trump says oil supermajors are making too much money. What will they do with it?
summary: Former President Trump has criticized oil supermajors like Exxon Mobil and Chevron for generating excessive profits, triggering political and environmental backlash. The windfall profits remain a point of contention in energy policy debates.
content: The windfall is fueling fresh political and environmental backlash, with Trump accusing Exxon Mobil and Chevron of making “too much money.”

zh.title: 特朗普称石油超级公司利润过高，他们将如何利用这些利润？
zh.summary: 前总统特朗普批评埃克森美孚和雪佛龙等石油超级公司产生过度利润，引发政治和环保反弹。这些意外利润仍然是能源政策辩论中的争议焦点。

title: U.S. reaffirms grip on Hormuz blockade, turning away 55 ships as talks stall
summary: The U.S. has turned away 55 ships as it maintains control of the Strait of Hormuz while diplomatic negotiations remain stalled. The ongoing blockade has disrupted regional shipping for over five months.
content: The escalating tally underscores how far the two sides remain from resolving a crisis that has choked the Strait of Hormuz for more than five months.

zh.title: 美国重申对霍尔木兹海峡的控制，拒绝55艘船只驶入，谈判陷入僵局
zh.summary: 美国在维持对霍尔木兹海峡控制权的同时拒绝了55艘船只驶入，外交谈判仍处于停滞状态。这一持续的封锁已经中断地区航运超过五个月。

title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole over salmonella risk
summary: Taylor Farms voluntarily recalled salsa and guacamole products due to salmonella risk after being notified of contaminated fresh peppers from a supplier. The recall affects multiple salsa and guacamole products distributed through the company.
content: The supplier voluntarily recalled the products, including salsas and guacamole, after being notified that Coast Citrus Distributors was recalling fresh peppers.

zh.title: 泰勒农场因沙门氏菌风险召回莎莎酱和鳄梨酱
zh.summary: 泰勒农场在得知供应商的新鲜辣椒受到污染后，自愿召回莎莎酱和鳄梨酱产品以防止沙门氏菌风险。该召回影响了通过该公司分销的多种莎莎酱和鳄梨酱产品。

title: U.S. stock futures dip as investors await inflation data, grapple with more Iran uncertainty
summary: U.S. stock-index futures remained largely stable as investors monitored Iran's renewed demands that threaten to jeopardize the Strait of Hormuz reopening deal, while awaiting critical inflation data later in the week.
content: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday, after new demands from Iran raised fresh doubts about the Strait of Hormuz reopening anytime soon and as investors await key inflation data later this week.

zh.title: 美国股指期货下跌，投资者等待通胀数据并应对伊朗不确定性
zh.summary: 美国股指期货基本保持稳定，投资者监视伊朗新提出的可能危害霍尔木兹海峡重开协议的要求，同时等待本周晚些时候公布的关键通胀数据。

title: Oil rises amid uncertainty over U.S.-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
summary: Oil prices rose as traders assessed conflicting signals from U.S. and Iran negotiations over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, with growing concerns that a deal may not materialize soon.
content: Oil rose as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not be coming anytime soon.

zh.title: 由于美国-伊朗霍尔木兹海峡协议的不确定性，油价上升
zh.summary: 由于交易员评估美国和伊朗关于重开霍尔木兹海峡谈判中的相互矛盾的信号，加上对协议可能无法很快达成的日益增长的担忧，油价上升。

title: Could your tattoo stop you from getting a job?
summary: Despite one-quarter of the UK population having at least one tattoo—including the sitting Prime Minister—tattoos remain controversial in hiring decisions. Workplace discrimination based on body art persists despite widespread prevalence.
content: A quarter of the UK population – including the new prime minister – have at least one tattoo, but they still divide opinion in the workplace.

zh.title: 你的纹身会妨碍你找到工作吗？
zh.summary: 尽管四分之一的英国人口至少有一个纹身（包括现任首相），但纹身在招聘决策中仍然存在争议。尽管纹身广泛存在，基于身体艺术的工作场所歧视现象仍然持续。

title: S&P 500 futures slip as traders watch for Strait of Hormuz deal, inflation data: Live updates
summary: Following the S&P 500's best week since April and a new all-time closing high on Friday, stock futures dipped as traders focused on developments in Strait of Hormuz negotiations and upcoming inflation data.
content: The three major indexes are coming off their best weeks since April, and the S&P 500 finished Friday at an all-time closing high.

zh.title: 交易员关注霍尔木兹海峡协议和通胀数据，标普500期货下跌：实时更新
zh.summary: 在标普500指数经历4月以来最好的一周并在周五创下历史新高之后，交易员关注霍尔木兹海峡谈判最新进展和即将公布的通胀数据，期货市场出现下滑。

title: ‘I’m easing into retirement’: I’m getting an $80,000 pension payout. Where can I invest it safely?
summary: A retiree receiving an $80,000 pension payout seeks guidance on safe investment strategies while planning to defer distributions from their 401(k) in coming years. The question addresses retirement income management and asset allocation.
content: “I expect to have several years before I take distributions from my 401(k) account.”

zh.title: "我在逐步退休"：我获得了8万美元的养老金支付。我在哪里可以安全地投资？
zh.summary: 一位退休人员在获得8万美元的养老金支付后，寻求关于安全投资策略的指导，同时计划在未来几年推迟401(k)分配。这个问题涉及退休收入管理和资产配置。
